_source: Tools/data/Profession_FAQ.md, supplied by the repository owner. Values are taken from it as written, with these spelling corrections: 'Iron Forge' -> Ironforge, 'Shadowspray/Shadowsprey Village' -> Shadowprey Village, 'Dushwallow' -> Dustwallow, 'Inkeeper' -> Innkeeper. Entries the FAQ marks as unsure ('Una? in Thunder Bluff?') are not used.
_noLevelRequirement: The FAQ: gathering professions, Cooking and First Aid have no level requirements. Survival and Jewelcrafting are Turtle-lineage additions the FAQ predates; Jewelcrafting trains like the other primary crafts, and Survival is treated as having no requirement until a source says otherwise.
_supplementTrainers: Ranks the reference document lists no trainer for, filled from the FAQ.
_secondary: Secondary professions do not train Expert or Artisan: Expert is a tome bought for 1 gold, Artisan a quest needing level 40 and skill 225.

artisan.gatherNote: Giant Eggs drop from level 40+ rocs in Tanaris (plenty near Gadgetzan) or owlbeasts in The Hinterlands. Zesty Clam Meat comes out of Big-mouth Clams, dropped by Muckshells and Threshers in Dustwallow Marsh, Naga Explorers in Stranglethorn Vale and Hatecrests in Feralas. Alterac Swiss is 40 silver per stack of 5 from Ben Trias in Stormwind City (Alliance) or Innkeeper Sikewa in Desolace, Shadowprey Village (Horde).

artisan.finishNote: Triage: 15 patients in the right order before 6 die. Stand where you can see all six cots, put the special triage bandages on your action bar, and treat Critically injured first, then Badly injured, then Injured.
